title: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 150 of the Acts of 1990 the Commission of the Department of Public Utilities makes an assessment on the intra-state revenues of various electric companies for the funding of the Integrated Resources Management Program.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Werlin, Chm., Tierney and Alexander (90-54-D).

In accordance with the provisions of chapter 150, of the acts of 1990. The Commission of the Department of Public Utilities, makes an assessment on the Intra-State Revenues of various electric companies for the funding of the Intergrated Resources Management Program.
